strings.TMD_sky_reavers_desc: Airborne bandits are a new and terrifying plague upon the benighted lands of Russia. Descending from the skies faster than any land-bound vehicle, their helicopter fleet allows the Airborne Brigades to surround, pillage and raze flat whatever isolated community they please before their rivals can respond. It will take more than a few old planes from the 40s to end their reign of terror.
strings.TMD_unified: Invincible Junta of the Imperial Guard
